name: Marigold & Rye
intro: A twelve-table café and deli in downtown Portland. The board follows the clock — breakfast off the bakery run, lunch from the deli counter, small plates and a glass in the evening. When a dish runs out, it stays on the board, struck through, until tomorrow.
addressNote: Two blocks from Pioneer Courthouse Square — look for the tomato-red awning.
hoursNote: The kitchen takes its last order thirty minutes before close.

faqs.question: Do you take reservations?
faqs.answer: No — we are walk-in first, and the room turns over quickly. For groups of six or more, call ahead and we will hold the window table when we can.

faqs.question: Can I order food to take away?
faqs.answer: Everything on the board travels well. Call before you arrive and we will have it wrapped and waiting at the counter — there is no online ordering.

faqs.question: How do allergies and diets work?
faqs.answer: Dishes are tagged V, VE, GF, and N on the board. Tell the counter about any allergy and the kitchen will walk you through what is safe today.

faqs.question: Why is a dish greyed out?
faqs.answer: It is sold out. The kitchen cooks in small batches, so when something runs out it stays on the board — struck through — until tomorrow morning’s run.
